label: Best months
quote: awe-inspiring place to visit in summer season

label: Hike from Laddu, other reports
value: Laddu to the lake about 4 to 6 hours (Kiddle); about 1 hour from Utror to Laddu's old site (PakWheels, 2013)
quote: From Ladu, it takes about four to six hours of hiking to reach Kundol Lake.

label: Hike time, river bridge
value: 3 to 4 hours from the river bridge, by Pakistan Highlands
quote: The path towards the Kandol Lake continues along the river on sandy and stony path.

label: The road
value: Jeep from Kalam to Utror about an hour; jeeps now stop a couple of km past Utror
quote: these days only a couple of km ahead of Utror

label: Jeep time
value: About an hour from Kalam to Utror by a privately hired jeep
quote: It takes about an hour from Kalam to Utror by a privately hired jeep.

label: Before you go
value: The Laddu bridge was broken in 2013; check the crossing before you start
quote: The bridge to Laddu is broken.
source: PakWheels trip report, June 2013 (dated; check current status)
